clue.text: Pure breaks in Oslo, possibly luxurious place to go

parts.note: the Norwegian capital, taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A traveller in Norway takes a pure break in Oslo, perhaps somewhere luxurious.
explanation.definitionFit: A superloo is a deluxe public lavatory, and a lavatory is a place you go when you need to go.

clue.text: I will be found underneath large bricks etc?

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
the ego is the self, the I

explanation.surface: Someone says they will be found beneath a big pile of bricks.
explanation.definitionFit: Lego is the toy construction system of plastic interlocking blocks, hence the question mark on the brick definition.

clue.text: Adult badger relaxed

to badger is to pester or tease

explanation.surface: A grown badger lying about calmly.
explanation.walkthrough: Badger looks like the animal, but here it is the verb meaning to pester.
explanation.definitionFit: Being at ease means being comfortable and free from tension, an idiom for calm.

clue.text: Bury hosts grand European number

explanation.walkthrough: Bury looks like the Lancashire town, but it is the verb meaning to put in a grave.
explanation.definitionFit: An integer is a whole number, with no fractional part.

clue.text: Natural to welcome oddly edgy opposite

indicators.note: oddly points to the letters in odd-numbered positions of the next word

explanation.definitionFit: A negative is the opposite of a positive, and as an adjective it means contrary or opposing.

clue.text: Pat alerted about temporary addition to new estate?

explanation.walkthrough: The estate is an estate car, not housing; a trade plate is a temporary number plate a dealer puts on an unregistered vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: Dealers fix these temporary registration plates to unregistered vehicles, including a brand-new estate car being driven before registration.

clue.text: Observation using psychic powers in all likelihood seen up-front

explanation.definitionFit: Espial is an old word for spying or watching, the act of observing something.

clue.text: Off and on, Angus cattle close to Midlands town

explanation.walkthrough: Angus looks like the breed of cattle, but supplies letters only. Nuneaton is a town in Warwickshire.

clue.text: Depart in extremely enticing topless garment

clue.text: Wings of airplane or back of aircraft

explanation.walkthrough: Back of aircraft reads like the tail, but back turns the word before it round and of aircraft is the definition.

clue.text: Unfortunate bloke missing first trick

a dude is a bloke, a man

explanation.walkthrough: Trick looks like a card-game noun, but it is a verb, the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Illude is a rare literary verb meaning to deceive or fool someone, related to illusion.

clue.text: Rough time, 50% of team being run-of-the-mill

indicators.note: fifty percent means half, so the second half of the word is dropped

parts.note: rough ground is uneven

explanation.walkthrough: The team must be guessed: Fulham is a London football club, and its first three letters are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Something uneventful has nothing notable happening, much like the ordinary and routine.

clue.text: Way-out questions?

setter's reading: questions put to people on their way out of a polling station

explanation.walkthrough: Way-out normally means weird, but here it is literally on the way out, as voters leave after casting their ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: This survey asks voters leaving polling stations how they voted, to predict an election result.

clue.text: Siren in collieries barely active after loss of current

explanation.definitionFit: The Lorelei is the Rhine maiden of German legend whose singing lured boatmen to their doom, like a Greek siren.

clue.text: Mammals in lair bitten by English terriers repeatedly

explanation.definitionFit: Edentata is the old taxonomic order of toothless animals such as sloths, anteaters and armadillos.

clue.text: Old coins aired in works

indicators.note: works suggests the letters are worked over and rearranged

clue.text: Available where subs may be working

clue.text: Social deportment of a princess married lady entertains

clue.text: Case of medicine clears up tissue-hardening

taken as written

clue.text: Arguably become startled with lush artist

clue.text: Smuggled bottles over bay
